description: A trailing comma and an unquoted key — the defects ADR-025 lists for Tier B JSON.
unsupportedReason: languageForPath() in packages/core-analysis/src/language.ts maps only ts/tsx/mts/cts/js/jsx/mjs/cjs/py/pyi/go. It returns null for this extension, so no analyzer is ever selected and the file is never read. ADR-025 accepts this language as Tier B (validation-only) but no validator is implemented. This case exists so the gap is counted, not forgotten — and so that the day a validator lands, its output is measured against a written expectation instead of being trusted.
